name: Overheat
description: Tracks the damage this unit deals to each enemy. Once one has accumulated %threshold% damage it overheats, applying %burn_stacks% stack of Burn to every other enemy within %radius% tile.
details: An overheating unit never burns itself, only its neighbours.
Each enemy can overheat at most once per turn, and overheating empties its counter - damage past the threshold is lost.

upgrade.summary: Damage past the threshold is kept rather than burned off.
details: An overheating unit never burns itself, only its neighbours.
Each enemy can overheat at most once per turn.
Overheating takes exactly %threshold% off the counter and leaves the rest, so a single huge hit banks most of the next overheat.
